title: Senior Network & Security Engineer
description:
Implementation and support of customer enterprise network and security infrastructure (multi-site, UAE customer sites; occasional after-hours change windows).
Responsibilities:
- Install, configure and troubleshoot routing & switching: Cisco routers, Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Meraki MS, Aruba switches
- Firewalls/NGFW: Cisco Firepower (FTD), Cisco Meraki MX, ASA; exposure to Check Point, Palo Alto and Fortinet is a plus
- NAC/AAA: Cisco ISE (PAN/PSN/MNT, PxGrid), 802.1X/MAB wired and wireless, posture, TACACS+; Aruba ClearPass exposure is an advantage
- L2/L3 troubleshooting; hardening, configuration backups; HLD/LLD documentation; ServiceNow; mentor junior engineers; support presales
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / IT
- 5+ years enterprise network and security implementation or operations; multi-site delivery
- OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, VLANs, STP, VTP, LACP, HSRP, DNS, DHCP, NAT; VPN site-to-site, GRE, DMVPN, IPsec
- Hands-on Cisco ASA/Firepower, HA/failover; Cisco ISE deployment, Dot1x/MAB, posture, TACACS+
- Working knowledge of cloud networking is a plus. Industry certification on relevant technologies.

title: Senior Network & Security Engineer
description:
Abu Dhabi client site, full-time, 8+ years. UAE experience mandatory. Currently based in the UAE with a valid Emirates ID, which will be required for the security clearance process if shortlisted.
Senior engineer for operational support and project delivery for a client's firewalls, load balancers, NAC and secure email in a ticket-driven, SLA-bound environment.
Strong expertise in at least five of: Juniper and Huawei product experience highly preferred; NAC Cisco ISE; firewall Palo Alto; load balancing F5 or Kemp LoadMaster; routing & switching Juniper; FortiMail; Kemp; ITIL.
Core requirements: 8+ years network & security engineering; incident/ticket management, root cause analysis, SLA adherence; works solo at client site. Certifications preferred.

title: Senior Network & Security Engineer / Senior Network Consultant
description:
Onsite network and security consultancy and support in a large enterprise environment, 1-year consultancy engagement in the UAE. L1/L2/L3 troubleshooting within an ITIL framework; after-hours and weekend support when required.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering / Computer Science / IT
- Minimum 5-7 years managing large enterprise network environments
- CCNP certification is mandatory
- Strong enterprise networking and troubleshooting; ITIL framework experience
Preferred Certifications: CCIE, Fortinet NSE, F5 Certified BIG-IP Administrator, CISSP
Additional preferred: penetration testing; ManageEngine monitoring; previous experience supporting UAE Government / Public Sector customers is highly preferred.

title: Senior Firewall & Perimeter Security Engineer
description:
On-site Dubai. Senior network engineering plus perimeter security: technical authority on network boundaries.
Responsibilities:
- Architect, deploy and manage NGFW (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco); IDS/IPS, WAF, secure VPN gateways
- Threat mitigation and incident response; firewall rule audits, ACLs, security policy aligned to ISO 27001 and NESA
- Secure routing (BGP, OSPF), switching; vulnerability assessments and penetration testing support
Required Qualifications:
- Minimum 10 years hands-on network and perimeter security with senior network engineering background
- Configuring and troubleshooting enterprise firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, secure web gateways
- TCP/IP, OSI, routing protocols, packet analysis
- Certifications: active certifications highly preferred (e.g. CISSP, PCNSE, Fortinet NSE 7/8, CCIE/CCNP Security, Check Point CCSE)
- Mentor junior engineers; communicate security risks to non-technical stakeholders

title: L3 Security Engineer
description:
L3 security support: firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, WAF, SIEM and endpoint security; incident response and root-cause analysis; Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco, Check Point; vulnerability management, hardening, compliance.
Requires L3 candidates with 13+ years hands-on experience and deep troubleshooting.
Required: Palo Alto Certification (Required). Deep troubleshooting 10 years (Required).

title: Security Engineer
description:
Cybersecurity consultant with presales support, technical workshops, demonstrations and implementation across identity & access management, data protection, encryption, PKI, key management, cloud security. Works with senior consultants and aims to develop into a consultant or solution architect.
Experience: 5 years in cybersecurity or IT infrastructure; exposure to IAM, HSM, PKI, KMS. Preferred certifications: CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, Microsoft SC-900, SC-300, AZ-900, Network+.

title: Senior Engineer - ICT / Security
description: Construction supervision team: oversee installation and delivery of ICT, ELV and security systems on major construction projects; review shop drawings, submittals, ITPs; witness testing and commissioning of structured cabling, fibre optic, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, public address, intercom. Minimum 13 years in ICT/ELV engineering with 7 in construction supervision or PMC/consultancy. GCC experience preferred.

title: Network Engineer
description: Network Engineer with 3 years hands-on experience, mainly switching. CCNA certification mandatory. VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP, EtherChannel, inter-VLAN routing, port security, DHCP snooping; L1/L2 support; Cisco Catalyst preferred. Required: 3 years relevant experience, CCNA (mandatory).

title: Network Engineer / Network Operations
description:
Enterprise campus network operations: Ruckus wireless estate, access and distribution switching, FortiGate firewall and security posture. L2/L3 support; 802.1X, RADIUS; FortiGate HA, IPsec VPN, SSL-VPN, SD-WAN rules.
Required: 5+ years hands-on enterprise networking with 3 years owning production wireless and firewalls; Ruckus administration; FortiGate administration; L2/L3 switching; 802.1X, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS.
Preferred: Fortinet NSE4 and NSE5 or NSE7; Ruckus certification; CCNA / CCNP Enterprise; UAE driving licence preferred.
